pinnedFiles.reason: Defines PathClaims/PathClaim — the interface and struct this feature extends. MustExist already has a comment flagging it as the seam for a deleted-file field ("the flag exists so a future field can opt out explicitly"). ImplementationState.PathClaims() and QAState.PathClaims() here are what filesDeleted/testFilesDeleted must be added to.

verifyOneClaim only ever checks MustExist==true (missingPaths). The new deletion check — path absent now, existed at stage start — is new logic that belongs beside it; this is the file whose shape the acceptance criteria (ClaimError wording, field-naming) must match.
Owns the ImplementationState struct, its PathClaims() entries, and requireTouchedFiles — AC asks that a deletion-only implementation still counts as having touched something, which is this function.
Owns QAState, which needs the parallel testFilesDeleted field per the acceptance criteria.

Defines the WorkTree interface (Digest, ChangedPaths, HeadRef, DiffLinesSince) and changedPaths(). The spec requires checking a deleted path 'existed when the stage started... tracked at the run's base commit, or in the tree the posture check saw' — this is the only existing mechanism that observes the tree's prior state, and the analyst must decide whether it's sufficient or needs a new WorkTree method.
Holds resolveWithinRoot, fileExists, and projectRootFor — the primitives missingPaths (claims.go) is built from, and whatever existence check filesDeleted needs will reuse them.

Schema generation is struct-driven, never hand-edited (StageSchemas, Generate, Decode, documentFactories). Adding filesDeleted/testFilesDeleted means adding fields to the Go structs and running the generator — the analyst needs to know schemas are derived, not authored, so the task breakdown includes 'regenerate shared/schemas/pipeline/*.json' rather than editing the JSON by hand.

Shows the existing test idiom for claim verification (runQAWithPayload, writeAt, a fabricated-then-true-then-escaping-path progression) that the Test Approach section asks the new tests to follow: a real deletion, a deletion that didn't happen, a never-existed path, a rename reported both ways, and an old -> new entry.

Generated artifact the AC directly names ("each has an optional filesDeleted or testFilesDeleted array"). Pinned to show the current generated shape developer/analyst must diff against after adding the Go field — not to be hand-edited.
Same as above, for testFilesDeleted on the QA schema.

pruned: internal/state/conditional.go — declares conditional-requirement rules (e.g. structuralDecision.fitness) for a different kind (architecture); not the mechanism this feature needs, and pinning it would suggest filesDeleted's rename-syntax rule belongs in that table when it more plausibly belongs in Validate() on each affected state struct

internal/state/state.go — holds generic ValidationError/firstError/requireText helpers; useful but inferable from implementation_state.go and qa_state.go's existing calls to them, and the 10-file cap is tighter than including it
cmd/gen-schemas — the schema generator's entrypoint; schema.go already shows the generation API the analyst needs, and the entrypoint itself is mechanical (go run cmd/gen-schemas)

shared/contracts/implementation-contract.md and shared/contracts/qa-contract.md — prose contracts for the markdown rendering of these states; the feature is about the typed JSON claim-checking path, not the markdown contract, and spec explicitly scopes to internal/state, internal/orchestrator, shared/schemas/pipeline

docs/features/pre-ship-checks/* and docs/features/intake-slice-check/* — same Agent Orchestration bounded context as prior deliveries, checked for retrospectives; neither has a retrospective.md (only docs/features/2026-07-aos-foundations-and-frontmatter/ has one, and it belongs to a different bounded context), so nothing to pull forward

internal/orchestrator/executor.go — orchestrates stage execution generally but is not where claim verification or the field additions live; verifyPathClaims is called from here but the call site itself needs no change for this feature
